QuestInfo.name: Dreaming of Alchemy
QuestInfo.0: Dr. De Lang's daughter has a dream. Listen to what her dream is.
QuestInfo.1: As the daughter of Dr. De Lang and Phyllia, Keeny wants to become an Alchemist like her father. But Phyllia believes that to be dangerous and is against it. Go get Keeny some experiment material in secret to help her with her dream of becoming an Alchemist.
QuestInfo.2: You've given Keeny the experiment material to help with her dream of becoming an Alchemist without having Phyllia find out.

0.0: I want to become a great alchemist like my father when I grow up, but my mother says no. She says that being an alchemist is difficult, dangerous, and makes hardly any money. But I don't care! This is what I want to do. Will you help me?

yes.0: I want to do some simple experiments, but mother is keeping a close eye on me so I can't get my hands on anything. If I had #r15 #t4009070##k and #r#t4009071##k, I might could get a small experiment going. Can you get me these things without letting my mother find out?

no.0: No one can stop my dream! I'll just do it myself. I guess...

1.0: Pssst... Over here. Mother will take everything away if she catches us.

default.0: Go get #r15 #t4009070##k and #r#t4009071##k for me without Mother finding out.
